title: A Strategy Without a Budget Is a Wish

frames.narration: Here is a principle. A strategy that is not backed by numbers, and checked against them, is not a strategy. It is a wish.
frames.intent: The viewer hears the thesis plainly and expects it to be proven.
frames.layout: Grid chalkboard, empty chart frame. Four centred serif lines; 'a wish.' last, in brand blue, with gold sparkles.

elements.text: A strategy not backed by numbers,

motion.what: 'It is a wish.' rises in; 5 gold sparkles pop around it

frames.narration: To see why, follow one company through one year. A wealth manager's service team and its AI plan. By the end, you'll see the one number that shows whether the plan is on track.
frames.intent: Whose story this is, plus one open question: which number?

frames.narration: So most of the money goes into repeat work. But the unusual questions, the ones that need a person, can wait up to a day for a reply.
frames.intent: The mismatch: money spent on easy questions while hard ones wait.

frames.narration: Therefore, the plan was built like a simple machine, with three parts. What you will do. What it will cost. And how you will know it is working.
frames.intent: A map of what's coming, and a reason to keep watching.
frames.layout: Three interlocking gears across the centre (cream, blue, cream), labels under each: Work, Cost, Tracking. Title 'The plan' above.

frames.narration: First, the work. Seven uses of AI, from an assistant that answers routine questions to tools that route each request and help agents reply faster. Five phases, over twelve months.
frames.intent: The plan is concrete and phased.
frames.layout: Small 'Work' gear badge top-left. A row of 7 icon tokens across the upper half. Below, a 0-12 month axis with 5 coloured brush segments: Discover 0-2, Pilot 3-5, Integrate 6-8, Scale 9-12, Optimize (arrow beyond).

frames.narration: Second, the price. One point two million dollars for the year. Seven hundred thousand, spent once, to build. Four hundred thousand, recurring, to run. And one hundred thousand, held back.
frames.intent: The total, and the three kinds of money inside it.
frames.layout: '2 · Cost' badge top-left. Title '12-month AI budget'. One wide brush bar that splits into three: build (deep navy), run (brand blue), reserve (orange). Labels above each with amounts; '$1.2M total' bracket below.

frames.narration: Third, the part most plans leave out. Every month, actual spending is checked against the plan. And at fixed points, the team must choose. Scale it. Improve it. Or stop it.
frames.intent: Tracking and explicit decisions make the plan real.
frames.layout: '3 · Tracking' badge. 12 monthly bar pairs (plan = cream outline, actual = blue fill) across the left 70%; at the right end a drawn three-way signpost: Scale (up), Improve (loop), Stop (red).

after the line ends: wipe to brand end card, logo fades up
